data.name: Ketan
data.gender_notes: Ketan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ketu’, meaning ‘Spark, Light, or Joy’. In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a planet representing spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name ‘Ketan’ symbolizes the illumination of one’s soul as they progress on their spiritual journey. The name Ketan carries the meaning “Spark, Light, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ketan usually hope their child will grow to embody spark, light, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Illumination of the soul on the spiritual journey
data.etymology: Ketan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spark, Light, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ketan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name ‘Ketan’ has drawn its roots from ancient Hindu culture and mythology. It resonates with the richness of Indian tradition and is a reflection of the deep spiritual beliefs present within the Hindu society.
data.spiritual_significance: The name ‘Ketan’ is blessed with deep spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the illumination of one’s soul and the progression towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, the planet Ketu is believed to possess the power to bestow spiritual knowledge and divine insight upon its devotees. A person named Ketan is believed to carry this divine energy within them, inspiring them to seek higher knowledge and understanding of the universe and their place within it. It is a constant reminder of the spiritual quest that every human being must embark upon in their lifetime.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ketan, derived from Sanskrit 'Ketu', represents wisdom and intuition. It symbolizes the inner guide, the silent observer within, guiding one towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Ketan Rao, a prominent Maratha commander during the late 17th century, was a key figure in the military campaigns of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. He was instrumental in the expansion of the Maratha Empire and is known for his victories against the Mughal and Adilshahi armies.
historical_references.context: Military commander in the Maratha Empire expanding under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj

historical_references.reference: Ketanrao Gaekwad, a 17th century Maratha subahdar (governor) of the Deccan, played a significant role in Maratha expansion in the region. He was a powerful military leader and diplomat, who maintained alliances with various regional powers and helped to establish the Maratha dominance in the Deccan plateau.
historical_references.context: Maratha subahdar of the Deccan expanding Maratha dominance in the region
